fact: Business in Cameroon reports that the Posts and Telecommunications Minister opened bidding on 31 October 2025 for the rural connectivity component of the World Bank-backed PATNUC, funded with 55 billion XAF, to connect 328 unserved 3G localities by 2028.
source_slug: 2025-11-09 Cameroon aims to connect 328 rural communities by 2028 (PATNUC)

fact: PATNUC says a strategic meeting in Yaounde on 8 July 2025 prepared World Bank-financed 3G coverage for 328 rural white-zone localities, with a tender for 120 firm sites and 208 conditional sites targeted before 30 December 2026.
MINPOSTEL, with World Bank support under PATNUC, validated a national universal digital service strategy on 8 July 2025 whose deployment axis aims at full coverage of underserved areas by 2030.
